title: Aprio broadens its AI-powered advisory partnership with Intuit to further accelerate mid-market business growth
summary: Strategic collaboration combines AI, data, and industry experience.
body_markdown:
Strategic collaboration combines AI, data, and industry experience to transform how advisory services are delivered to scaling, more complex businesses.


Aprio, the 20th largest business advisory and accounting firm in the US, today announced the next phase of a strategic partnership with Intuit, the global financial technology platform that makes


[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,


[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,


[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,


[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,


[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) and


[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite/) . The deepening partnership is designed to accelerate innovation across the accounting profession, and help shape the future of AI-powered advisory and accounting services for mid-market businesses.


[Aprio and Intuit will work together](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/news/intuit-aprio-mid-market-business-growth/) to develop AI-powered solutions designed to help identify tax planning opportunities, benchmark business performance, improve financial visibility, and support more informed decision-making across industries, including


[construction](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/midsize-business/ai-in-construction/) , dental, wealth management, and


[tax](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/taxes/) . Aprio’s subject matter specialists will work alongside Intuit’s product, engineering, and AI teams to turn real-world client needs into industry-specific capabilities that deliver greater visibility into business performance and enable more opportunities for advisors to focus on strategic guidance.


“Aprio's partners and advisors work alongside business owners every day, giving us a unique perspective on where growth is happening and where new opportunities are emerging," said Marc Silverman, chief commercial officer, Aprio. “Together with Intuit, we're bringing those insights directly into the development of AI-powered solutions across tax, wealth management, dental and construction. By combining Aprio's industry experience with Intuit's technology and AI capabilities, we will shape tools that enable our professionals to spend more time helping clients pursue what's next.”


"Delivering data-driven insights and leveraging AI to streamline accountant workflows enables them to drive and accelerate their clients’ growth,” said Travis Walter, senior vice president and chief sales officer, SVP, Intuit. “Furthering our partnership with Aprio allows us to combine the power of their expertise with our financial technology platform so all firms have access to the products and services they need to deliver advisory services to their clients.”


The partnership supports both organizations' commitment to innovation and the responsible application of artificial intelligence. By combining advanced technologies with deep advisory capabilities, Aprio and Intuit aim to help accelerate the evolution of accounting and advisory services and create new value across the business lifecycle. The collaboration builds on the


[strategic partnership announced in October 2025](https://investors.intuit.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1275/intuit-and-aprio-partner-to-accelerate-mid-market-business-growth-with-ai-powered-advisory-and-technology) , when Aprio became Intuit's first advisory and accounting firm partner focused on accelerating mid-market business growth with client implementations of


[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) , Intuit’s AI-native ERP for modern finance teams. This next phase expands the relationship beyond technology implementation to include AI innovation, industry-focused solutions, and new ways to help clients grow.


### About Intuit


[Intuit](http://intuit.com/) is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for consumers, businesses, and accountants, with products including


[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,


[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,


[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,


[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,


[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) and


[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite) . Intuit's financial intelligence brings together decades of trusted data, deep financial expertise, AI, and human experts to help customers at every stage of their financial journey. This puts more money in their pockets, saves time by reducing manual work, and ensures they have complete confidence in every financial decision.


### About Aprio


Aprio is redefining what it means to be a global advisory and accounting firm. We help businesses and individuals Account for Anything™—delivering clarity and confidence in a world full of unknowns. Aprio is the brand name under which Aprio, LLP, and Aprio Advisory Group, LLC deliver professional services to clients worldwide. Aprio Advisory Group, LLC provides advisory, tax, legal, wealth, and talent solutions to help build value, drive growth, manage risk, and protect wealth, while Aprio, LLP delivers audit and attest services with uncompromising quality and integrity. With more than 3,500 team members serving clients in 50+ countries and $5.8B in assets under advisement as of June 30, 2026, Aprio, the 20th largest business advisory and accounting firm in the U.S., is consistently recognized as a Top Workplace, celebrated for transformative growth on the Inc. 5000 and Inc. Power Partners lists, and led by Richard Kopelman, named to Accounting Today’s Top 100 Most Influential People in Accounting. Learn more at Aprio.com.
